description: This file implements libevent-based integration for QUIC, including event loop management, socket registration, alarm handling, and event notification within the quic namespace.

classes.name: LibeventAlarm
classes.description: Represents a QUIC alarm integrated with libevent, managing timer setup and cancellation.

classes.name: LibeventQuicEventLoop
classes.description: Implements a QUIC event loop using libevent, managing socket registration, event dispatching, and alarms.

classes.name: LibeventQuicEventLoop::Registration
classes.description: Handles registration of sockets and event notifications within the libevent loop.

classes.name: QuicLibeventEventLoopFactory
classes.description: Factory for creating instances of LibeventQuicEventLoop with optional level-triggered configuration.

methods.name: LibeventEventMask LibquicEventsToLibeventEventMask(int events)
methods.description: Converts QUIC socket event mask to libevent event mask.

methods.name: QuicSocketEventMask LibquicEventsToLibeventEventMask(QuicSocketEventMask events)
methods.description: Converts libevent event mask to QUIC socket event mask.

methods.name: QuicArenaScopedPtr<QuicAlarm> LibeventQuicEventLoop::AlarmFactory::CreateAlarm(QuicArenaScopedPtr<QuicAlarm::Delegate> delegate, QuicConnectionArena* arena)
methods.description: Creates a new LibeventAlarm, possibly within a specified arena.

methods.name: LibeventQuicEventLoop::Create(QuicClock* clock, bool force_level_triggered)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new libevent-based QUIC event loop with optional level-triggered mode.
